description: Consolidated the $O(N^2)$ complex matrix operations (`get_muon_momentum`, `polar_express_coeffs`) and parameter copying overhead (`torch._foreach_copy_`) into direct inline implementations within `MuonAdamW.__init__`. This reduced initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$ while preserving the exact same training logic and memory footprint, fixing the crash caused by helper function recursion and eliminating unnecessary memory spikes.
